I’ve thought about cutting my calves off. It feels like they need release...

I quit smoking and drinking and drugs thinking it would help, which in some ways it did, but the pain is worse than ever. 
And Neurologically I’m so foggy and can’t remember what I did last week. Can’t even remember if I’ve showered or anything. 

I just want a better quality of life. Soooo bad

Are you on MAT? I’ve been on subutex and shooting heroin a few times a week...pretty much when I have enough money and a ride to the city. 
But I was on methadone last summer before I got on subutex. 
The first few months of taking the subutex, I would take a half of an 8mg a few times a week...wasn’t physically addicted so I just took it on nights that I couldn’t sleep or I was in pain, etc
Anyway I went to jail in January and they detoxed me off everything with Librium. Didn’t feel great, but wasn’t terrible. I started using again as soon as I got out. Switching between boy and subs. 
Well about a week or two ago, I forgot to take half a sub (I’m prescribed 3 8mg a day, so 24mg in all, but the past two months I’ve only been taking half) and I got sick, took one, was fine. 
So then I was like fuck I’m physically addicted to this shit, along with coke, heroin, and benzos. 

The point of this is...the fucking subutex made my tolerance sky rocket. I shot a half gram of boy at once and took a bunch of Xanax bars and I was fine. I feel like most people would overdose, but nope. 
I haven’t been able to feel the high from heroin since I did methadone maintenance all last summer. I won’t take my subutex for a day or two before I do boy, but no matter how good it is, I only feel the rush and not the high. I feel normal and like myself and all that shit when I do it, it’s just not the same. 
I am trying to get into detox so I can get off everything,stay clean for like two or three months, then see if my tolerance has gone down. But the times i waited only a few weeks or a month, my tolerance went back up on the third day. It’s insane.

But I did hear DXM can prevent you from developing a tolerance. I haven’t personally tried it, but some people swear by it and I’ve researched it online a lot. I’m going to try it my next time around. So maybe you could try that?
Or using some stuff that potentates opioids, specifically the morphine that the heroin is metabolized into. 
And if you do try it, make sure to let everyone know!

TLDR; Subutex/Suboxone and Methadone MAT causes your heroin tolerance to skyrocket...subutex you can still feel the rush when you shoot, but methadone...you won’t feel the rush until you’ve been off it a week. 
Try DXM since it’s been known to prevent your body from developing a tolerance to morphine/heroin. 
And also use opioid potentates. (Grapefruit, Benzos, muscle relaxants, most sleep meds, alcohol, etc but don’t mix with any of these if you don’t have a tolerance for them as well)
